title: [review] x509 appendix + draft-rpl DAO source binding still mandate rejected SHA-512 native profile
description: Found during jqh2 (worker5) review convergence. spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md:80 (verifier behavior step 4) requires recomputing SHA-512(subjectPublicKey)-based native address and rejecting mismatch — post-migration this rejects conformant AddrForKey-bound certificates. Also spec/drafts/draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00.md:277 (DAO Source Address Model) still specifies '[0x02] + SHA-512(pubkey)[0:7] + IID' as the source-binding derivation. Both must migrate to upstream AddrForKey per spec/decisions.jsonl upstream-yggdrasil-addressing. The x509 appendix has HEAD-only commits (ac03cbb8cc etc.) not on any other worker branch, so it needs a fresh edit, not a cherry-pick.
